top_signals.title: Australian Home Auctions Decline as Rate Hikes Dampen Activity
top_signals.summary: The number of homes auctioned in Australia dropped over the past week as interest rates at a 15-year high weigh on activity in the housing market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
